question: What is the largest minimum bid size that exchanges may require, so that demand response, storage and small renewables can take part in day-ahead and intraday trading?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 8(3) of Regulation 2019/943 says NEMOs shall provide day-ahead and intraday products with minimum bid sizes of 500 kW or less, to allow effective participation of demand-side response, energy storage and small-scale renewables.
